title.en: Your Browser Automation Breaks When the Site Changes. Mine Heals Itself.
title.zh: 网站一改版自动化脚本就废？聊聊自愈回放的完整设计

description.en: A deep dive into building a deterministic self-healing replay engine on top of CDP: seven-layer selector resolution, fingerprint grading, coordinate fallback, and a knowledge base that remembers heals across runs.
description.zh: 在 CDP 上构建确定性自愈回放引擎的深度实战：七层选择器解析、指纹软硬分级、坐标兜底与跨运行知识复用。

tags.zh: 前端,自动化,测试,工程效率
